plain.li: [cl:Druid] I keep the grove's old craft, if your fields or your sick have need of it.
[cl:Druid] I'm a druid, so be kind to your trees while I'm about.
[cl:Priest] I'm a priest of my people, and I'll pray over your sick if you let me.
[cl:Priest] Call on me if anyone here is hurt, for I have the healer's blessing.
[cl:Paladin] I'm sworn as a paladin, and my hands can mend as well as fight.
[cl:Ranger] I'm a ranger, and I can tell you what walks your woods at night.
[cl:Arcanist] I study the arcane, so don't be alarmed if the air hums near me.
[cl:Chronomancer] Time bends a little around me, as it does around any chronomancer.
[cl:Enchanter] I'm an enchanter, and I can tell good work from great at a glance.
[cl:Geomancer] The stone listens when I speak, which comes of being a geomancer.
[cl:Technomancer] Machines and I understand each other, as a technomancer's should.
[cl:HeartOfFrost] I carry the cold in me, and the rain comes when I call it.
[cl:StormBorn] I was born in a storm, and the lightning still knows my name.
[cl:InnerFire] I carry a fire inside, so keep your thatch well away from me.
[cl:TM_Bard] I'm a minstrel, and I'll pay for my supper with a song.
[cl:TM_Wanderer] I'm a wandering mage, a little of every craft and master of none.
[cl:TM_Monk] I'm a monk of my people, and I mostly keep my hands to myself.
[cl:Gladiator] I fought in the ring once, and I've the scars to show for it.
[cl:TM_Sniper] I can put a shot through a keyhole from across a valley.
[cl:TM_Commander] I lead wherever I go, so forgive me an order or two.
[cl:Summoner] Don't mind the things I call up, they behave for me.
[cl:TM_Psionic] My mind pushes as hard as my hands, so I keep it calm.
I'm {ACRAFT}, should anyone here have need of one.
Among my people I'm known as {ACRAFT}, for what that's worth to you.
They call me {ACRAFT} at home, and I've earned the name.
{ACRAFT}, here, talking to me like it's nothing.
I've heard of {CRAFTS}, but I never thought to meet one.
So that's what {ACRAFT} looks like up close.
Wait till the others hear we had {ACRAFT} at the gate.
I'll mind my manners around {ACRAFT}, then.
[cl:Druid] A druid, so we'd best mind our axes while you're here.
[cl:Priest|cl:Paladin] A healer's blessing, here at our gate.
[cl:TM_Bard] A minstrel, then the evening won't be quiet.
[cl:HeartOfFrost|cl:StormBorn|cl:InnerFire] I'll stand a little further off, if it's all the same to you.
They've {ACRAFT} with them, so keep your heads down.
Watch that one, that's {ACRAFT}.
That one's {ACRAFT}, don't let them get close.
They brought {ACRAFT} along, so this won't be an ordinary fight.
I know that look, that's {ACRAFT} out there.

[cl:Arcanist|cl:InnerFire|cl:HeartOfFrost|cl:StormBorn|cl:Druid|cl:Priest|cl:Geomancer|cl:Technomancer|cl:Enchanter|cl:Chronomancer|cl:Summoner|cl:Necromancer] Take {ACRAFT} down first, before the spells start.
[need:heal] There, that will close clean now.
[need:heal] Rest a while, the worst of it is mended.
[need:heal] It's knitting, so give it a day and it won't trouble you.
[need:cure] The sickness is out of you, so go and eat something.
[need:cure] That one won't come back, not after this.
[need:scar] Old scars fade slowly, but that one will fade a little faster now.
[need:scar] Some hurts are old, but they can still be eased.
[need:rain] The sky owed you this much.
[need:rain] There, let it fall.
It's done.
[need:heal] It hardly hurts now, thank you.
[need:heal] I felt it close, like warm water over the wound.
[need:cure] The fever's gone, just like that.
[need:cure] I can breathe again, thank you.
[need:scar] The old scar feels softer somehow.
[need:rain] Rain at last, and all they did was raise a hand.
[need:rain] Smell that, the ground is drinking it in.
Thank you, truly.
